content:
We need correct functional group names. For broken groups: we want to break "alcohol" (maybe "aliphatic hydroxyls" or "aromatic hydroxyls") and "ketones". Also break "C-C double bonds" (alkene). So functional_groups_broken should be ["aliphatic hydroxyls","ketones","C-C double bonds"].

Formed: we form "aliphatic hydroxyls"? Actually we form alcohol, so formed is "aliphatic hydroxyls". Also we form "ketones"? No we form ketone from broken? In forward reaction we form alcohol, break ketone. So in retrosynthesis we break alcohol, form ketone. So functional_groups_formed should include "ketones". Also we form alkene (since forward consumes alkene). So functional_groups_formed includes "C-C double bonds". So broken: aliphatic hydroxyls, maybe also "C-C single bonds"? Not needed. Let's try search with broken: ["aliphatic hydroxyls","ketones","C-C double bonds"]; formed: ["ketones","C-C double bonds","aliphatic hydroxyls"]? That seems contradictory. Actually we need to specify forward reaction changes: broken groups are those that disappear in forward direction. In forward carbonyl-ene: ketone disappears (becomes alcohol), alkene disappears (becomes new C-C bond). So broken: "ketones","C-C double bonds". Formed: "aliphatic hydroxyls". Also a new C-C bond formed, but that's not a functional group. So we can set functional_groups_broken=["ketones","C-C double bonds"], functional_groups_formed=["aliphatic hydroxyls"].

Let's try that.
